responsibility: Exercises and benchmarks the TinyList container’s core behavior by validating insertion, membership checks, and element removal across head, tail, middle, and single-element cases, while providing microbenchmarks for common empty and one-element operations.
same_name_distinction: Unlike most other same-named test files, this one mixes correctness tests with microbenchmarks, focusing on `TinyList` membership and removal at head, tail, middle, and singleton positions plus benchmark coverage of tiny-operation cases.
